# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime and platform reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves rendering reliability, memory use, and platform support across managed and native workloads. This unreleased work speeds up image and text processing, fixes front-buffered streams, synchronizes Android texture rendering, and updates the supported Apple deployment baselines.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily** — Releases retained stream data promptly so applications that read through front-buffered streams avoid avoidable memory growth. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Synchronizes texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for more reliable Android presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Linux HarfBuzz uses bundled symbols locally** — Binds HarfBuzz functions from the bundled native library on Linux, avoiding reliance on externally resolved symbols. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed image pixel copies are more efficient** — Reduces overhead when copying image pixels through the managed API. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text shaping reduces temporary allocations** — Pools UTF-32 encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocations during HarfBuzz shaping. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Apple deployment baselines updated** — Raises the minimum supported deployment versions for Apple targets. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **WebGPU support is packaged with the native WebAssembly library** — Includes emdawnwebgpu's WebGPU implementation in libSkiaSharp.a for WebAssembly consumers. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
